column1: # Unit A2.4 — Talking about the past: yesterday, your story
# Editorial content: written for Lingua Match. See content/README.md for the cell syntax.

column7: Yesterday I went to the cinema. | Yesterday I went to the movies.
Last night I stayed at home.
column8: Gestern Abend bin ich zu Hause [geblieben:verb].

column7: I met a friend in town.
column8: Ich habe eine Freundin in der Stadt [getroffen:verb].
column9: [Quedé:verb] con una amiga en el centro.
column10: Ik heb een vriendin in de stad [ontmoet:verb].

column12: You see a friend in the morning after they stayed at yours.

column7: I've already seen that film. | I've already seen that movie.
First we ate, then we danced.

column12: A friend sends you a message that just says: "You won't believe this…"

column7: I grew up in a small village.
column8: Ich bin in einem kleinen [Dorf:noun] aufgewachsen.
column10: Ik ben in een klein [dorp:noun] opgegroeid.

column7: I moved here three years ago.
column8: Ich bin vor drei Jahren hierher [gezogen:verb].
column10: Ik ben drie jaar geleden hierheen [verhuisd:verb].

column7: I used to live in Madrid.
I went to school in Ankara.
column8: Ich bin in Ankara zur [Schule:noun] gegangen.
column10: Ik ben in Ankara naar [school:noun] gegaan.

column7: My life has changed a lot.
In the future I'd like to live abroad.
column8: In [Zukunft:noun] möchte ich im Ausland leben.
column9: En el [futuro:noun] me gustaría vivir en el extranjero.
column10: In de [toekomst:noun] wil ik in het buitenland wonen.
